subject: Hospitality
title: The $1.1 Trillion Events Industry
description: One-minute skill: The $1.1 Trillion Events Industry.

hook.text: The global events industry is worth $1.1 trillion—larger than the entire GDP of Indonesia. Every gathering is an economic engine.

buildup.text: Events include conferences, weddings, concerts, trade shows, sports, festivals, and corporate meetings.

discovery.text: For every dollar spent on a conference, $2–3 circulates through the local economy.

twist.text: COVID-19 erased 80% of event revenue in 2020. The fastest-growing industry became the fastest-collapsing overnight.

climax.text: By 2024, the industry recovered and exceeded pre-pandemic levels. People need to gather.

punchline.text: $1.1 trillion, larger than Indonesia's GDP. Bringing people together is massive business.

quiz.question: How much is the global events industry worth?
